description: Abstract class for processing message mappings within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging framework, including methods for resolving conditions, handling mappers, and building exceptions.

classes.name: AbstractMappingProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class for processing message mappings with generic input and output types, providing utility methods for condition resolution, exception creation, and mapper retrieval.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Abstract method to process an incoming message of type I, returning a list of mapping outcomes of type O.

methods.name: resolveConditions
methods.description: Resolves a collection of condition strings using an ExpressionResolver, returning true if all conditions evaluate to true.

methods.name: buildMappingFailedException
methods.description: Creates a MessageMappingFailedException with detailed error information based on the provided parameters.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MessageMapper instances based on the provided PayloadMapping, defaulting to a registry's default mapper if none are found.
